purpose: Create a new rules-only Crazyhouse opening corpus for the owner-required local same-network paired gate without inheriting an unlicensed historical book or observing engine results.

reference.required_checkout_state: exact detached clean checkout with loaded module below that checkout

generator.seed_utf8: Crazyhouse-Stockfish local same-network opening corpus v1
generator.choice_algorithm: Sort the complete legal move set by UCI text. Hash seed || NUL || uint64be(candidate_index) || uint16be(ply) with SHA-256. Interpret the full digest as a big-endian integer modulo the legal move count.
terminal_rejections: checkmate before or at target depth
stalemate before or at target depth
fivefold repetition before or at target depth
generator.duplicate_rejection_key: board placement including promoted flags and pockets, turn, castling rights and legal en-passant field
generator.canonical_output: six-field bracket-pocket FEN with PNBRQpnbrq pocket order and legal-only en-passant

qualification_requirements: Generate once into a fresh lease namespace and regenerate independently for byte-exact comparison.
Authenticate every trajectory by replay from the standard Crazyhouse start position in the exact pinned python-chess checkout.
Authenticate all EPD rows through the exact qualified referee conformance parser.
Run one fixed-node, non-timing referee dry pair from the generated book and prove the same opening with swapped colors.
Require the exact candidate and adapted comparator to load the exact legacy network and return a legal bestmove on the dry pair.
Preserve raw stdout, stderr, PGN, generated files and per-file SHA-256 in the lease completion.

generated_data_license.dedication: To the extent possible under law, the Crazyhouse-Stockfish contributors waive all copyright and related or neighboring rights in this generated corpus.

resource_contract.foreign_process_policy: read-only; no stop, suspend, resume, affinity or priority changes

pass_effect: Only the exact generated opening corpus becomes eligible for the separately frozen local panel. Time control, adapter overhead, host cleanliness, match schedule and strength remain independent gates.
fail_effect: Preserve the namespace, emit an immutable result, and do not substitute the quarantined historical book.
